summary: No arithmetic, query-join, GT-metadata or selected-best mismatch. One open document formatting defect D2; source render defect D1 is retained historically. No blocking scientific/code defect or new execution gate.

A_gt_provenance.details: Protocol identities and camera/scene fields are dataset metadata; every path identity/environment and every legal-positive count was independently checked. Full query order matches each saved table. Different-identity distractors remain, including those in the same environment. Image bytes and distance tensors were outside scope.

B_normalization.details: AP averages precision at every legal positive across the complete legal gallery; mAP/CMC average all valid protocol queries. New deltas use 100*(ambiguity AP-uniform AP). Full transition contributions divide by dataset N; nested transition contributions inside a stratum divide by that stratum N despite the reused all_query field name. Only the outer stratum contribution divides by dataset N. Identity macro gives equal weight to each identity present in that subset; tail size is ceil(N/20), including zero changes if needed. No prediction-extrema/mean denominator inflates retrieval scores.

C_result_provenance_join_and_format.details: Every saved numeric/query/identity/tail/stratum field agrees with independent stdlib recomputation. All 30 intake digests, four comparison input digests, source digest and three format-receipt digests match. Joining by query_index independently confirms contiguous order, dataset identities and identical global reference values. Report data/scope are unchanged. D2 remains: the formatted report has five separator cells for four-column stratum headers. Binary hash strings are consistent producer claims, not locally recomputed binary hashes.

D_invoked_code.details: The preserved comparison source has only stdlib imports and invokes stats for full rows and both strata; its SHA matches the saved SUMMARY and its render order explains the preserved initial report. The four original endpoint reports have saved command arrays, exit0 and matching stdout, tracing main -> paired -> camera_scores/scene_scores. No separate comparison909 command/exit receipt is among the supplied artifacts, so source/output consistency is not independent execution attestation. No comparison producer or prior reporter was rerun.

E_scope_selection_and_claims.details: Exactly four completed endpoint receipts: two datasets x two conditions x one seed42 x 50 epochs. Latest maximal official mAP selects epoch 8/8 for RGBNT201 and 38/38 for MSVR310; every CMC comes from that same selected checkpoint. Official query/gallery metrics were used each epoch and the benchmarks were consumed in development. Global-rank1 strata are descriptive post-selection groups, not training ambiguity weights or a causal partition. No evidence for RGBNT100/full cohort, significance/stability/equivalence, teacher, a new inference comparator, same-model decomposition, unique failure cause or binary replay.

F_evaluation_type.details: Saved GT-scored retrieval evidence, reused in a descriptive comparison. It is not synthetic proxy GT, a new neural evaluation, a mathematical-causality experiment or independent binary/image replay.
